title: Mahale Mountains: Chimpanzees and a White Sand Beach
excerpt: Mahale Mountains combine chimpanzee trekking with white beaches on Lake Tanganyika. One of the most remote and beautiful places in Tanzania.
body:
Mahale Mountains National Park lies on a peninsula in Lake Tanganyika. Forested mountains rise straight up from white sand beaches and clear water.

## Chimpanzees

Mahale has a large population of wild chimpanzees, part of which has been studied by researchers for decades. With a guide you trek into the forest to find them, and spend a limited time with them.

## The setting

There are no roads into the park; you arrive by boat. You stay in a small number of camps along the lake.

## Other activities

- Swimming in the lake (ask locally where it is safe).
- Kayaking.
- Dhow trips at sunset.
- Forest walks.

## When

Roughly June to October is drier, and chimpanzees are often lower on the slopes. Some camps close in the long rains.

## Getting there

By light aircraft, often combined with [Katavi](/blog/katavi-national-park-guide/), followed by a boat transfer.

Read our [Mahale page](/national-parks/mahale-mountains-national-park/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
